title: Halwasiya buys 45 lakh shares of Baazar Style Retail for ₹163 crore in block deal - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Shares of Baazar Style Retail hit the 5 per cent upper circuit at ₹384 as Aditya Halwasiya acquired 45 lakh shares worth ₹163 crore in a block deal.

The investment comes at an important inflection point for Style Baazar, which has built a strong presence across eastern and other emerging markets and is now looking at a substantially larger canvas, with an ambition to rapidly expand its network to a minimum of 500 stores in three years.

The entry of Halwasiya, alongside the strategic investment already made by Cupid Ltd through warrants, represents about 12 per cent of the company on conversion.

Of these warrants about 3 per cent have already been exercised into equity shares. This has created a formidable new shareholder presence around the business and adds another dimension to Style Baazar’s next phase of growth.

Equally significant is the huge commercial potential for Cupid’s rapidly expanding consumer product portfolio, with Style Baazar’s growing retail footprint capable of providing a powerful platform for the sale, visibility and penetration of Cupid products across a large and growing consumer base.

The opportunity, however, extends well beyond the Style Baazar ecosystem, with the relationship potentially acting as a springboard for Cupid to accelerate the reach of its FMCG and consumer products across general trade, modern retail and other distribution channels throughout India.

The combination of Style Baazar moving towards a 500-plus-store network and Cupid simultaneously scaling its consumer business, creates the potential for a powerful retail and distribution ecosystem with significant cross-selling opportunities, wider product penetration and substantial incremental business for both companies.

With deeper penetration into underserved consumption markets, the expanding merchandise offering and the ability to leverage their respective strengths, Style Baazar and Cupid have the ingredients for a significant long-term strategic and commercial association.

The block transaction places a prominent new shareholder at the table as Style Baazar prepares for an ambitious expansion and transformation.
